name: Reset
note: boot: stack, watchdog off, ports, RAM clear, SRAM test, timers, SIO2, battery check, self-test check

name: Boot_SettleDelay
note: busy-wait before the first battery reading

name: Main_Loop
note: main loop: watchdog clear, idle entry check, then the tick work

name: Main_EnterIdle
note: nothing to do: slow tick (TREG2 0x03D5 = 1.0 s) and IDLE mode until an interrupt

name: Main_Wake
note: back from idle: normal tick

name: Main_Tick
note: work done once per 10.24 ms tick (flag E0.7)

name: Main_IdleResetTimer
note: counts ActivityTimer while not busy; wrap = reset as Init

name: Main_LowBattery
note: low-battery handling

name: Main_CamWatchdog
note: jam if the cam sensor does not change within 13 ticks (high) / 51 ticks (low)

name: Main_Commands
note: run the commands posted by the receiver (CmdRequests)

name: Cmd_Init
note: clear image memory, decoder, image-full, unprocessed (unless jammed), break block

name: Cmd_Print
note: take the 4 print arguments: copies, margins, palette, exposure

name: Cmd_Print_FeedOnly
note: 0 copies or no image data: feed the after-margin only

name: Cmd_Break
note: stop at the next feed phase; block data until Init

name: Main_JobControl
note: job end, copies, busy flag

name: Main_StartJob
note: start a mechanism job if no error

name: Job_StartHoming
note: state 0x11 (power-on homing)

name: Job_StartFeed
note: state 0x16 (feed only)

name: Job_ButtonFeed
note: state 0x17 while the front button is pressed

name: Job_StartPrint
note: print: temperature check, heat time, line pipeline set-up

name: Job_TempError
note: temperature reading outside 0x35-0xD7: other error (0x40)

name: Job_SetHeatTime
note: HeatTime = Tab_HeatBaseByTemp[temp] + ExposureOffset

name: Line_PrepareBand
note: extract and convert the next column for the strobe tables

name: Main_LinePipeline
note: line buffer refill / column preparation scheduling

name: Line_BuildColumnA
note: build strobe table A for the next column

name: Line_BuildColumnB
note: build strobe table B for the next column

name: Main_RefillLineBuf
note: copy 32-byte chunks from SRAM into LineBuf while printing

name: Data_Main
note: data decoder: runs in the main loop, fed by the ring buffer

name: Data_Loop
note: decode bytes until the packet ends

name: Data_PadSlot
note: compressed packet ended early: pad the slot to 640 bytes with 0x00

name: Data_Rollback
note: bad packet: restore the saved pointers

name: Data_Commit
note: packet stored: set unprocessed (0x08), update ImageBytes

name: Data_StoreByte
note: store one decoded byte; advance the slot every 640 bytes

name: Sub_CheckTempBattery
note: temperature (other error) and battery (low battery) checks

name: Sub_PrimeLineBuf
note: clear LineBuf and preload 0x120 bytes from SRAM

name: Sram_Read
note: A = SRAM[BC]

name: Sram_Write
note: SRAM[BC] = A

name: Rle_NextByte
note: next decoded byte from the ring buffer (CF = 1: none yet)

name: Sram_StorePos
note: SRAM position of the next packet byte: SlotBase + Tab_SramLayout[SlotOffset]

name: Tab_SramLayout
note: 640 words: packet byte index -> offset in its SRAM slot (tiles reordered by column)

name: Int_TC1_StrobeTick
note: TC1: write the next tick bytes to P0/P1; after 33 ticks stop TC1, sample battery

name: Int_TC3_BatteryCheck
note: TC3: battery reading under load

name: Int_INT5_ButtonWake
note: bare reti: the front button (P20 = INT5 pin) is enabled as an interrupt only to wake the CPU from IDLE

name: Int_INT4_CamSensor
note: cam sensor rising edge: MechFlags.CamSeen

name: Int_INT3_Encoder
note: encoder pulse: start a strobe burst, then run the mechanism state

name: Mech_Dispatch
note: jump through the state table with MechState

name: Mech_State01_Column
note: print states 01-10: one pixel column per state, 16 states per cycle, 10 cycles per band

name: Mech_State10_Column
note: last column state of a cycle

name: Mech_State11_Homing
note: power-on homing: find the cam sensor twice, stop 3 pulses after; clears PowerOnLock

name: Mech_State12_BandStart
note: before each band (13 pulses in the emulator)

name: Mech_State13_BandAdvance
note: between bands (115 pulses in the emulator)

name: Mech_State14_TopMargin
note: margin before printing

name: Mech_State15_BottomMargin
note: margin after printing (also the self-test)

name: Mech_State16_FeedOnly
note: print with 0 copies

name: Mech_State17_ButtonFeed
note: front button feed

name: Mech_State18_Stop
note: stop after low battery or Break

name: Mech_StateInvalid
note: states 0x19-0x1E

name: Int_TC2_Tick
note: main tick: set DecodeFlags.Tick

name: Int_SIO2_Receiver
note: packet receiver (coroutine resumed at RxResume after each byte)

name: Rx_PacketStart
note: first byte: must be 0x88 (0x11 bit-reversed)

name: Rx_AbortFF
note: reply 0xFF and drop the packet

name: Rx_Exit
note: end of packet

name: Rx_SyncLost
note: bad first byte: Init if idle, answer 0xFF until the inter-byte timeout

name: Rx_Header
note: command, compression, length; checksum starts

name: Rx_Data
note: data packet checks

name: Rx_DataPayload
note: payload bytes into the ring buffer

name: Rx_Checksum
note: checksum bytes; the status reply is built before the comparison

name: Rx_Reply
note: queue 0x81 and the status byte

name: Rx_PostCommand
note: post the command to the main loop if no error

name: Rx_OtherCommand
note: print / break / status / unknown

name: Rx_ReadArgs
note: keep up to 4 payload bytes in PktArgs

name: Rx_SkipWithError
note: packet error; sum and drop the payload

name: Rx_DataTooLong
note: length >= 0x400

name: Rx_IgnorePayload
note: ignored packet: payload summed (or skipped while busy)

name: Sub_BitReverse_Unused
note: unreferenced: A = bit-reversed A (the receiver inlines the same code); dead

name: Int_TC4_ByteTimeout
note: no byte for 5.12 ms: abort the packet, roll back data

name: Rx_WaitByte
note: save the return address in RxResume and leave the interrupt

name: Line_ExtractColumn
note: one bit position of the source bytes = one pixel column

name: Line_ColumnDots
note: combine the two bit planes into dot values (table 0xCCB6)

name: Tab_ColumnTabPtrs
note: 4 pointers: 0xD476, 0xD576, 0xD676, 0xD776 (used at 8FC6, 8FF2, 901E)
